messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: error_budget_burn_high for service=inference-runtime (severity: P2). pd_incident=PD123456
pagerduty: PagerDuty: alert PD123456 triggered. Auto-escalation scheduled.
sara-oncall: ack — looking into it now
ben-plat: @sara-oncall can you confirm customer impact? seeing 5xxs or throttles?
sara-oncall: checking logs & grafana... one sec
sara-oncall: grafana snapshot: https://grafana.redwood/snapshot/abc123 — sudden spike in request_rate and p95 at ~12:46 (3m window)
sara-oncall: quick tail of runtime logs: `kubectl -n inference logs -l app=inference | tail -n 200` shows repeated grpc errors: "rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded" between 12:46:47-12:48:10
maria-sre: any deploys around that time?
devops-bot: deploy-bot: release/2026-03-14T12:30 rolled by ci/cd — rollout complete 12:33, no canary failures
sara-oncall: initial hypothesis: transient traffic burst with a few very large batched requests + cold KV cache warmup causing tail latency and error budget burn
ben-plat: sounds like a classic batch+kv coldstart. mitigation options: reduce batch size or pre-warm KV cache. which is faster?
sara-oncall: reducing batching is fastest. applying hotpatch to runtime config now:
```
PATCH /configs/runtime
{
  "batching.max_batch_size": 16
}
```
Applied. Verifying metrics...
sara-oncall: p95 dropping back toward baseline within 45s. error budget alert cleared automatically by alert engine.
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PD123456 auto-resolved by alerting system (duration ~3m). Closing PD incident.
oncall-next: ack — taking over watch for the next hour. please leave a short handoff note
sara-oncall: handoff notes: transient burn due to short traffic spike + KV coldstart. Mitigation applied: max_batch_size lowered to 16. No customer-facing error pages reported, only rpc timeouts on a subset of long requests. Follow-ups: 1) add cold-start detection to alert rule 2) investigate KV warmup strategy (warm workers or prefill) 3) add runbook section and estimate runbook drill
ben-plat: filing a follow-up task and linking runbook. tagging incident/PD123456
maria-sre: creating backlog ticket now — assignee: infra-ml. link: https://issues.redwood/PD123456
ben-plat: :thumbsup:
incident-bot: PagerDuty escalation canceled; no further action required.
sara-oncall: ending thread — thanks everyone :pray:
